title: Open WebUI model profile image -- T1059.007 missing SVG validator on ModelMeta enables account takeover
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-54013 (GHSA-v2qm-5wxj-qhj7,
CVSS 7.6 HIGH), affecting Open WebUI prior to 0.9.6.

Open WebUI previously patched SVG-based XSS in user profile images and
webhook profile images, but the same fix was never applied to MODEL
profile images. `ModelMeta` has no `validate_profile_image_url` field
validator, and the model-image serving endpoint enforces no MIME
allowlist and sets no `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` header. Any
authenticated user holding the default-enabled `workspace.models`
permission can therefore store a `data:image/svg+xml;base64,...`
payload as a model's profile image; anyone -- including an
administrator -- who merely NAVIGATES to that image URL (no click, no
interaction beyond viewing) executes the embedded script under the
application origin, achieving full account takeover.

Detection logic flags a model profile-image field whose value is a
`data:image/svg+xml` URI -- the specific artifact class this advisory
describes; legitimate model profile images are ordinary raster formats
(PNG/JPEG) or hosted URLs, not inline base64 SVG.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD), fixed in 0.9.6.
